Get the secrets of Parisian chic with this full tutorial! ✨ Today, we’re crafting the iconic half-moon shoulder bag that has taken the fashion world by storm. Inspired by the equestrian-style Polène Numéro Dix, this silhouette is the ultimate "It-Bag" of 2026! 🌙👜

This minimalist masterpiece is a favorite among style icons and A-list celebrities. 🌟 It’s been spotted on Gigi Hadid and Kendall Jenner, who love its versatile, sculptural design. Even Princess Kate Middleton 👑 is a known fan of the brand’s timeless elegance. This bag is so sophisticated that it wouldn't look out of place on the Oscars red carpet 🏆 — it’s the perfect blend of "Quiet Luxury" and modern edge. 🎬💃
In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to achieve a high-end designer look at home using accessible materials. No professional studio is required! 🙌🪡

❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Canvas fabric (Main body) 🧶
🔹 Fusible interfacing / Flinezelin (60g density) ☁️
🔹 Fusible interfacing / Flinezelin (180g density for structure) 💪
🔹 Cotton fabric (Lining) 🌸
🔹 #3 Nylon coil zipper (Roll type) 🤐
🔹 4 Rivets (Optional) 🔘
🔹 Hand press for rivets (Optional) 🛠️
